title: HAX element docs data
description: Docs data for one element (lib/<tag>.docs.json), read by <documentation-player> and the component gallery. The element's build writes it with scripts/extract-element-docs.mjs in haxtheweb/webcomponents: change the element or its haxProperties and rebuild instead of editing this file by hand.

tag.description: The element's tag name. Packages without an element (utils) use their folder name.

version.description: Package version the data was built from.

title.description: gizmo.title from haxProperties, or the tag.

description.description: gizmo.description, the package description, or the first sentence of the class doc comment.

haxCapable.description: Whether the element has a HAX gizmo, so it can be inserted in the HAX editor.

import.description: Module specifier for the JS import snippet: <package>/<main file>.

cdn.description: CDN address of the element's module, for the script snippet and the live demo.

demoHtml.description: Demo markup built from haxProperties demoSchema. "" when there is none.

attributes.description: Attributes and properties, from the custom elements manifest.

slots.description: Slot names; the unnamed slot is "(default)".

events.description: Names of the events the element fires.

hax.description: The element's haxProperties (shown in the Schema tab). {} when it has none.

surfaceHash.description: Fingerprint of what a person can see and use: attributes, HAX settings, slots, events and demo schema. A walkthrough stores the hash it was written for, so a changed element marks it stale.

walkthroughs.description: Walkthrough storyboards (lib/<tag>[.<topic>].motion.json), the main one first.

videos.description: Video tutorials (lib/<tag>[.<topic>].video.json), keyed by the same topics as walkthroughs.

motion.description: The first walkthrough, for readers that show only one.

file.description: Storyboard path inside the package, or "" when there is none.

status.description: "none" when the element has no walkthrough; otherwise that walkthrough's status.

video.description: The first video tutorial, or null.

source.description: Where the element lives in haxtheweb/webcomponents.

path.description: Element folder, from the repository root.

property.description: Property the attribute maps to. Left out when the manifest names none.

type.description: Type as written in the manifest (string, boolean, …), or "".

default.description: Default value as source text ("false", "\"left\""), or "".

hax.description: The HAX setting bound to this property, or null when HAX has no control for it.

title.description: The setting's title. Missing when the haxProperties field has no title.

options.description: The setting's options (select / radio), or null.

id.description: Topic id; "" is the main walkthrough.

title.description: Name in the topic picker: the storyboard's title, or one made from the topic id.

order.description: Position in the topic picker (main 0, topics 100 unless the storyboard sets it).

src.description: Storyboard file name, next to this file.

enumDescriptions: Written for a different surface hash; the element changed since.
Matches the element, not yet approved by a person.
Matches the element and a person approved it.
status.description: Review state of the storyboard against surfaceHash.

id.description: Topic id; "" is the main video.

source.description: Video address (YouTube or a media file).

captions.description: WebVTT captions, relative to this file, or "".

tutorial.description: Link to the full tutorial, or "".
